messages.subject: Standard error estimation. Base understanding.
parts:
Dear community,

I would like to know how to estimate standard errors for a case like the one below (from this answer) without lavaan functions.

As far I understood lavaan uses the delta method, which is  the matrix multiplication of the jacobian matrix and the vcov matrix:
JAC %*% VCOV %*% t(JAC)

My problem is how to estimate the vcov matrix of the estimates without using the internal lavaan function or any other vcov() function, since I do not have a model object, but a optimization function.

I will really appreciate your help.
Marcos.


```
library(lavaan)
HS.model <- ' visual  =~ x1 + x2 + x3
               textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
               speed   =~ x7 + x8 + x9 '

fit <- cfa(HS.model, data=HolzingerSwineford1939, estimator = "ML") 

# initial list of model matrices
MLIST <- lavTech(fit, "start")

# sample covariance matrix
S     <- fit@SampleStats@cov[[1]]

# inverse and logdet of S
cS <- chol(S)
S.inv <- chol2inv(cS)
diag.cS <- diag(cS)
S.logdet <- sum(log(diag.cS * diag.cS))

# x is the parameter vector: fill in new values in the model matrices
x2MLIST <- function(x, MLIST) {
     lambda.x <- x[1:6]; theta.x <- x[7:15]
      psi.x <- x[ c(16,19,20,19,17,21,20,21, 18) ]

     MLIST$lambda[ c(2,  3, 14, 15, 26, 27) ]            <- lambda.x
     MLIST$theta[ c(1, 11, 21, 31, 41, 51, 61, 71, 81) ] <- theta.x
     MLIST$psi[ c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9) ]           <- psi.x

     MLIST
}

# objective function 'ML'
objective_ML <- function(x, MLIST) {

     MLIST <- x2MLIST(x = x, MLIST = MLIST)

     # compute Sigma.hat
     Sigma <- lavaan:::computeSigmaHat.LISREL(MLIST = MLIST)
     nvar <- NROW(Sigma)

     # ML
     cS <- chol(Sigma)
     Sigma.inv <- chol2inv(cS)
     diag.cS <- diag(cS)
     logdet <- sum(log(diag.cS * diag.cS))
     objective <- logdet + sum(diag(S %*% Sigma.inv)) - S.logdet - nvar
     cat("objective = ", objective, "\n")

     objective
}

# estimate parameters ML
out.ML  <- nlminb(start = start.x, objective = objective_ML,
                   MLIST = MLIST)
out.ML
# chi-square
out.ML$objective * 301
# 85.30551
```
